title: Basarabeasca railway workers’ wage protest resumed after a December start
notes: NewsMaker dates a Basarabeasca railway-worker protest to Dec 22 and separately identifies a Jan 5 Ocnița protest. Gagauzinfo’s Jan 5 result says Basarabeasca rail workers resumed protests in the new year and that actions began in late December; Noi republishes similar material. Treat this as a possible December-onset continuation, not a new January event. No exact end, headcount or evidence of nationwide coordination is available. Do not merge it with the distinct Ocnița action solely because both concern unpaid wages.
